metadata.description: A useful set of skills made by hardkoded

plugins.name: hardkoded
plugins.description: A growing collection of skills by hardkoded. Currently featuring cronito, a self-contained scheduled-task manager for your machine, and pr-memory, PR-keyed session memory that saves and restores agent context.

plugins.name: user-email
plugins.description: Optional mod that shows the signed-in Claude account email above the prompt. Install only if you want it.

plugins.name: usage-forecast
plugins.description: Optional mod that projects where the 5-hour usage window will land at reset, shown above the prompt. Install only if you want it.

plugins.name: inbox
plugins.description: Optional mod (from petekp/inbox) that gathers the questions, tasks, findings and PRs waiting on you in a session, and writes them to a status file. Install only if you want it.

plugins.name: consolidated-inbox
plugins.description: Optional mod that shows the open questions of all your sessions in one panel and sends your answers to them. Needs the inbox mod in each session.
